name: 6 of Us
description: A story of six siblings—Azize, Cemo, Zeliha, Fidan, Samet, and Balım—who, after suddenly losing their parents, struggle to stay united and survive. The roots of their tragedy trace back to their parents, Bala and Rıfat, whose forbidden love began in a village in Mardin. Rıfat, a teacher, falls in love with Bala, but Yavuz, the wealthy and obsessive son of Mardin’s richest family, kidnaps her. Despite his abuse, Bala escapes with Rıfat, and they build a secluded life in the forest, raising six children in peace. However, Yavuz’s revenge shatters their world when he finds and attacks them. Fleeing to Istanbul, the siblings face the dangers of the city while seeking refuge with “Uncle Aslan,” their father’s trusted friend. The story highlights resilience, as the older siblings are forced to grow up quickly to protect their younger brothers and sisters in the face of overwhelming challenges.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Bala and Rifat have built a small but happy life with their six children in a forest. Just as everything seems to be going well, a ruthless enemy from the past shatters the happiness of this beautiful family. Azize, Zeliha, Cemo, Fidan, Samet, and Balim... The children, who have lost their parents, find themselves in the back of a truck heading towards Istanbul as they flee from the men chasing them. However, for the children who have spent their entire lives in the forest, Istanbul is vast, unknown, and very dangerous. As they embark on a difficult struggle for survival in this unfamiliar city, they will make great efforts to stay together despite the dangers they encounter.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The children taking refuge in Hasmet's coal shed continue their struggle for survival, while Azize and Cemo make various sacrifices to take care of their siblings and meet their needs. Yusuf, trying to help the children, does his best, even at the cost of confronting his father. Yavuz, who wants to fulfill his mother's wish by finding Azize, continues his efforts to locate where the children are hiding. The children, who are in a state of great uncertainty regarding shelter, strive to stay together, and a great panic ensues when Balim suddenly disappears.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Balim, who has been kidnapped by Telli, faces death in a fire, while her siblings scramble to save her. Cemo risks his life by diving into the flames, but he is not sure if it is too late to save Balim. Cemo starts working hard to earn money in the job he got with Cevdet's help. Azize, on the other hand, takes advantage of a job opportunity and struggles to take care of her siblings. Yavuz, who wants to fulfill his mother's wish, strives to find Azize. As the circle of danger narrows even more, the brothers' struggle to hold on to life continues with difficulties.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The siblings, who suddenly encounter the toughest face of life, begin to realize how much harm their parents did by keeping them away from the realities of life, even though they were raised in a loving home. Facing this truth ignites arguments among the children. Azize, who tries to earn money by working alongside Duygu, faces an event that will make her feel very bad. Yavuz, trying to find Azize, gets one step closer to his goal. As their struggles with life continue at full speed, they slowly start to experience the excitement of discovering the feeling of love. However, this situation will also bring new dilemmas.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The siblings struggling to hold on to life face additional challenges as certain disputes make everything more difficult. While Yusuf provides as much support as he can to the siblings, he ends up confronting Cemo, leading to a major fight. The siblings, who have been uprooted from a secluded life to Istanbul, realize more with each passing day how their parents have actually left them to face a significant challenge. Yavuz, who has spread the word in all directions to find Azize, comes very close to his goal. Meanwhile, Cemo remains unaware that he is walking into the trap set by Yavuz, step by step.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: While Yavuz does everything he can to capture Azize, he sets a trap for Cemo to reach her. Cevdet, on the other hand, is in shock upon realizing that the siblings are Rifat's children, while the children experience the joy of finally finding their uncle Aslan. Cevdet, who never receives any appreciation from his mother and siblings, eventually rebels against this situation and asks Necla to vacate the house. However, this sudden outburst ignites a major argument in the apartment. The time has come for Yavuz to confront Cevdet, having made all the preparations to take Azize.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Yavuz, who has no intention of giving up on Azize, demands Azize in exchange for Cemo's life. While this offer angers everyone, Azize realizes she doesn't have many options as she doesn't want to risk her siblings' lives. The departure of their sister becomes a disaster for the siblings, while Remziye and Necla implement a new plan to get rid of them. Azize, who does not want to accept that Yavuz is her real father, finds herself trapped in a deadlock, and learning about Hamiyet's plan for her makes everything even more challenging. Cevdet, unable to prevent Yavuz from taking Azize, is very upset about the situation, but he is ready to do everything he can to save Azize.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Azize, taken to Mardin by Yavuz and Hamiyet, is forced to marry Devran to end a blood feud. Cevdet and Cemo, who set out to rescue Azize, embark on a very dangerous mission by following her. Fidan, Samet, and Balım being taken to the orphanage is a great devastation for the children. Zeliha, who is separated from her siblings, makes a plan with Yusuf to rescue them. However, unexpected complications arise, making the situation even more complex. While Azize, who does not want to marry Devran, realizes she has no other option, she makes a great sacrifice with the decision she takes to save her siblings.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Azize, who has to marry Devran, angers Cemo and deeply disappoints him. The capture of Yavuz allows everyone to breathe a sigh of relief. Azize, who makes a great sacrifice to ensure the safety of her siblings, goes to the orphanage with Devran to pick them up. However, their unexpected encounter with Faruk leads to tension between Devran and Faruk. The children, who leave the orphanage, are bewildered by the new situation their sister is in. Faruk, aware that Azize was forced into marriage, has no intention of giving up on this love. However, Devran, who cannot bear to see them together, will not hesitate to use all his power over Azize.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Faruk thinks that Azize is being forced into marriage and, while trying to protect her, comes face to face with Devran. This situation increases the tension between the two. Azize makes many sacrifices to protect her siblings' lives and tries to eliminate the threat of Yavuz. Fidan witnesses a special closeness between Zeliha and Yusuf. This development further intensifies the conflicts she has with her sister. Cemo gets involved in a fight to protect Melis and faces great danger. Cevdet does everything he can to protect the children but finds himself in the middle of an attack.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Faruk, who wants to save Azize from Devran, puts both his and Azize's lives in danger with his actions. Azize, who survives the accident unscathed, continues her conflicts with Devran from where she left off. Feeling the need to earn money to take care of his siblings, Cemo refuses any support that might come from Devran and starts seeking a solution. Witnessing a special closeness between Zeliha and Yusuf, Fidan continues to react to the situation. Cemo reaches the brink of sharing his feelings for Melis, which grow stronger day by day. Finding herself in a challenging test with her marriage to Devran, Azize puts up a great struggle to manage the process.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Learning that Vera is the reason behind Devran's desire to stay in Istanbul, Azize becomes angry and scolds Devran. Deciding to stay with her siblings, Azize's step is met with joy by the little ones. Not wanting to hide her love for Yusuf any longer, Zeliha decides to shout out this truth at all costs. When a secret they kept from the past is revealed, Hasmet and Necla find a solution in selling the bracelet to make Melis forgive them and convince her of a plan. While this development upsets the children very much, Samet and Balım make their own plan to get the bracelet. On the other hand, Azize starts working to stand on her own feet and save the bracelet. However, Devran has a surprise prepared for Azize and her siblings.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Cemo is furious with Yusuf's relationship with Zeliha and a huge fight breaks out between them. While the tension between the two continues, the job they started to earn money gets them into big trouble. Forced into marriage by Hasmet, Melis takes action to learn some facts about her father. However, what she hears creates a great disappointment for her and immediately causes her to make an important decision. Azize starts working as a shop assistant in a store and this causes conflicts between her and Devran. However, the biggest tension occurs when Pervin and Hamiyet get involved in the incident. Pervin, who does not find this job appropriate for Alazlar's daughter-in-law, has Azize fired. Azize, who is enraged by this situation, stands up to Pervin and says the words that no one else dares to say. Seeing the closeness between Devran and Azize turns into an unbearable pain for Vera.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Pervin's pressures cause the conflict between Azize and Devran to continue. Melis, who is engaged to Cevat, begins to question whether this path is right for her. Cemo, who is forced to reject Melis' offer to run away together, decides that he needs to earn a lot of money in order to be strong and continues to progress in dangerous businesses. While Azize is making great efforts to be with her siblings, Samet and Balım, who are excited about being in school, are disappointed not to see Azize with them. Fidan, who thinks that she is the one who has the most responsibility for the little ones, rebels against this situation. Devran, who wants Azize to be in his sight, convinces her to work in the hotel kitchen at the expense of confronting his mother. However, this situation ignites the fuse of new conflicts.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Melis' decision to get married causes Cemo to become very angry. Cemo, who continues to engage in dangerous jobs in order to earn money, does not hesitate to take risks. Azize is upset by the situation Vera is in. However, Vera, who does not want to lose Devran, says she wants to have a child from him. Zeliha's start to work at the hotel leads to jealousy conflicts between her and Yusuf. The relationship between Necla and Ercan causes a major crisis in the Hasmet household. Pervin, who wants to have a grandchild, increases the pressure on Devran and Azize. She catches a hope in her own way that this dream will come true soon. However, Vera's appearance and the news she gives creates a great shock effect on everyone.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: When Vera confronts Pervin and tells her that she is pregnant, the tension increases even more. While Pervin reacts strongly to this situation, the development causes tension between Azize and Devran. Vera, who tries everything not to lose the man she loves, accuses Devran of being in love with Azize. Melis, who is about to embark on a new path with Cevat, reproaches her mother Necla for not loving and supporting her unconditionally. There is a difference of opinion between Cemo and Yusuf, who wants to help Duygu. Yavuz, who is in love with Vera, makes a plan to take revenge on Devran. Azize, who argued with Devran about Vera's pregnancy news, is in great shock with the news she receives from Berşan.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Cemo and Cevdet embark on an operation to rescue the girls held captive by Abbas. Fidan, who feels the need to be loved and accepted, has her good intentions and feelings abused by Kerem. Azize, who is angry with Devran, tells him that her only and only priority in her life is her siblings. Devran, who wants to have a valuable place in Azize's life, is saddened to hear these words.  Zeliha, who is trapped by her co-worker Mehmet, goes through very difficult times. Vera, who thinks that Devran does not value her as he used to with Azize's entry into his life, is in great anger. Vera, who is hellbent on revenge on those who hurt her, will take a step that will be a critical turning point for Azize.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Azize being shot by Vera creates great devastation for everyone, especially Devran. The fact that their sister was shot is hidden from Samet and Balım. After this incident that happened to Azize, Melis wants to give Cemo the support she can, but Cemo is still a little distant from her. Cemo, who thinks that Istanbul has not been good for them at all, wants to return to the forest with his siblings. While Zeliha is not keen on this idea, Fidan, who is disappointed in Kerem, and Samet and Balım, who are having a hard time at school, agree that returning to where they came from is the best thing for them. As they take action together for this decision, they are unaware of the great disaster that will happen to them.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Devran, Cevdet and Yusuf, who learn that the brothers were kidnapped by Abbas, take action with great anger. Vahap, who is angry that his bride Azize was kidnapped, gathers his men and begins to follow Abbas's trail. While Abbas makes a terrible plan for the girls, a cruel fate awaits Cemo. While Devran and Cevdet are gradually approaching Abbas to save Azize and her siblings, Zeliha and Fidan make a brave attempt to escape from Abbas's hands. However, not everything goes as planned. Azize, who refuses to bow down to Abbas, is sure that Devran will save her, but she is very worried about what Cemo has experienced. The operation to rescue the brothers will be extremely difficult and dangerous.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Devran, Cemo and Yusuf spend a night of their own while putting an end to their disagreements. When Haşmet joins them, the fun reaches a whole new level. Samet and Balım attend the camp organized at their school with Devran and Azize. This camp helps the children warm up to Devran even more and also contributes to the strengthening of the closeness between Azize and Devran. Going to Kerem's house, Fidan encounters a truth that surprises her very much. The closeness that develops between Duygu and Cemo causes Melis to feel bad. In response to this situation, Duygu decides to suddenly reveal her past with her uncle Haşmet. This development causes tension in the environment. Azize protects Duygu; however, Devran, who does not think well of Duygu, confronts Azize.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Azize, who received backlash from Devran for standing up for Duygu and supporting her, decides to do what she believes is right by not backing down. This situation causes the conflict between her and Devran to continue. The return of Yusuf's ex-fiancee Buket from abroad is a sign of possible tensions between Yusuf and Zeliha. Fırat, who says he has a score to settle with Vahap Alaz, suddenly appears before her, claiming that he has a right to all of her wealth. Pervin and Devran are very angry with this man, whose identity they do not yet know. It turns out that Samet, who fell ill while playing football at school, has a serious problem with his heart. This development deeply shakes his siblings.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: The problem that has emerged in Samet's heart deeply saddens his brothers. He needs to have an operation as soon as possible in order to recover. However, the high cost of the operation forces the entire family and those around them to mobilize. The brothers, Cevdet, Yusuf and the people of the neighborhood do everything they can to find the necessary money. Azize decides to sell the bracelet she inherited from her mother. Fidan, on the other hand, associates a strange prophecy she heard from Kerem's mother, Güliz, with Samet's illness and becomes very worried. Meanwhile, Fırat's arrival and demands cause the crisis in the Alaz family to grow even more. Fırat is determined to take everything that belongs to Devran. While the anxious wait continues for Samet, who is taken into surgery, an unexpected negative development shakes everyone deeply.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: When Samet's long-awaited surgery goes wrong, this unexpected situation throws everyone into great fear. Trying to find the money for the surgery, Cevdet finds a solution by borrowing money from a loan shark. However, this debt pulls him into a dangerous vortex. Fırat, who is becoming more strident against Vahap to get his rights, openly reveals that he also has his eye on the Alaz surname. While the disturbing rumors about Devran spreading within the tribe make the Alazs angry, Devran's insistence on having a child escalates the tension between him and Azize. The large inheritance left to Buket excites Haşmet. Haşmet begins to take some steps to bring Yusuf and Buket together again. Pervin, who sees Devran having a child as a vital issue for the continuation of the Alaz line, finds the solution in bringing Azize as his second wife. This decision causes the conflicts between Devran and Azize to grow even more.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Pervin, who wants to continue the Alaz lineage and fulfill the tribal traditions, increases her pressure on Devran to have a child as soon as possible. In return, Azize insists on making this decision of her own free will, when the time comes. When Fırat learns that the Pervins are interested in Meryem for Devran, he becomes very angry. Yusuf and Zeliha's relationship deteriorates and eventually leads to an inevitable separation. This situation especially makes Haşmet and Remziye happy. Squeezed into a corner by the pressure he receives from his family, Devran cannot control himself and takes a step that will further increase the tension between him and Azize. On the other hand, while Devran is moving step by step towards an unwanted marriage with Meryem, Azize, with a last effort, pulls off the wedding.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Seeing Devran marry Meryem, Azize shows a huge reaction and breaks the window frame. Support comes from someone she never expected, Hamiyet. Meryem marrying Devran also causes great anger on the Euphrates front. Tempers are tense between the brothers and guns are drawn. Azize, who is completely tired of the impositions made on her about having a child, rebels. Cemo, who is informed of the shocking developments, reacts very harshly to Devran and a big argument breaks out between them. The cold winds blowing between Yusuf and Zeliha take the conflicts to a new level. Haşmet and Remziye continue their efforts to fix the relationship between Buket and Yusuf. After all these events, Azize, who does not want to leave Devran alone with Meryem, is very shocked by what she witnesses.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Cemo, who is very angry about Devran marrying Meryem, reacts to his sister continuing to support Devran. Azize, who does not doubt Devran's intentions, openly expresses her love for him. Azize, who was subjected to pressure during the marriage process, makes it a condition that Devran and his family come and want her again in order to relive this process as she wishes. While Devran accepts this condition without hesitation, Vahap and Pervin do not approve of this situation at all. New developments occur in the conflict between Zeliha and Yusuf. Pervin, who does not want Azize to have the child who will continue the lineage of Alazlar, begins to make a plan to take Devran away from Azize. Meryem, who feels left out in the cold, puts a very dangerous plan into action.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Trying to support the happiness of the young people, Cevdet Baba decides to ask for Zeliha's hand in marriage to Yusuf. Hearing about this development, Hasmet reacts to the situation by slightly misunderstanding the issue. Suspecting that Meryem is behind the poisoning incident, Azize confronts her. Wanting her granddaughter to be happy with Devran, Hamiyet says that she wants to do Azize's henna night and the preparations begin. Thinking that Meryem is not being taken care of, Grandma Kevi is very angry with Alazlar because of this situation. Despite all the difficulties and obstacles experienced, Azize and Devran, who take care of each other and their love, are impatient to be alone.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Although Pervin tries to prevent it, everyone, especially Cevdet, mobilizes to hold Azize and Devran's wedding. While the siblings share this excitement, developments that will make them happy occur in each of their lives. Meryem, who thinks she has been treated unfairly, feels great resentment to make her pay for it. Yavuz, who thinks that Hamiyet has given up on him, is very angry with Devran, who he sees as the reason for this situation. Fırat, who thinks that he has suffered great pain from Vahap in the past, prepares a plan to take his revenge. While Azize, Devran and the siblings live their happiest days to their heart's content, they are unaware of what will happen to them.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: As the neighborhood mourns under the shadow of three coffins, Devran awakens from his coma thanks to Azize's hope. However, his return home is devastating: Cemo is now in a wheelchair, Cevdet is dead, and Devran has no trace of his old life left. Burning with revenge, Azize stops Devran and urges him to build a "new life." Meanwhile, Haşmet and his family hold Devran and Azize responsible for what happened and demand they leave the neighborhood immediately. Despite everything, Devran is determined to get his family back on their feet, but this path will be much more difficult than he imagined. All eyes are now on the revelation of the will Cevdet wrote years ago.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Cevdet’s will turns the balance of the neighborhood upside down. While this inheritance gives Azize and her siblings a home for the very first time, it shakes the Kılıç family to its core. Azize is overjoyed to finally have a place to stay, but Devran, out of pride, refuses to live in the house. Cemo hides away in the coal cellar to escape the crowded household; Zeliha cannot erase the scars of her past and finds solace in a woman she meets at the mosque. Meanwhile, Yusuf starts working alongside Firuze, unaware of the test that awaits him with Bahar. At the same time, as Devran tries to expose Emrah’s theft, Yavuz puts his plan into action. Haşmet and Necla, fueled by the rumors spreading through the neighborhood, turn Azize and her family into targets. From now on, surviving in this neighborhood will be far more difficult than they ever imagined.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: While Azize, Devran, and the children become the target of an angry crowd, Firuze comes to their aid and takes them into her home. However, this refuge creates a rift between Devran and Azize. Distrusting Firuze and wanting to solve problems on his own, Devran clashes with Azize, who—out of concern for the children’s safety—reluctantly agrees to stay with Firuze. Meanwhile, Cemo is shaken by the anger of being falsely accused, and Yusuf’s arrest—caused by Bahar’s ex-lover Taylan—deeply wounds Zeliha. Haşmet and his family seize the opportunity of Azize and her family leaving the house to pursue their own interests. On the other hand, Firuze, determined to protect the family entrusted to her by Cevdet, prepares to confront the neighborhood. Devran, increasingly isolated and desperate, is forced to start a new job just to keep his family afloat. Yet this desperation will push both Devran and Azize to the brink of decisions they never wanted to make.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Wanting to return to his former days of power, Devran accepts Yavuz’s offer to work together at the hotel. However, he makes great efforts to hide this development from Azize. Devran’s real plan is to expose Yavuz’s dirty dealings and eliminate him. Determined to avenge his parents, Cemo starts working at the hotel to get close to Yavuz. Unaware of these schemes, Yavuz does not realize the danger bells ringing for him. Meanwhile, Azize’s growing closeness to Firuze greatly displeases Devran. When Devran accuses her of neglecting her siblings, Azize refuses to bow down. After seeing Yusuf with Bahar, Zeliha finds herself quickly drifting toward a major crossroads. And at last, Cemo seizes the opportunity he’s been waiting for to catch Yavuz off guard.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Azize is deeply disappointed to learn that Devran has been secretly working at Yavuz's hotel. However, the news that Yavuz has been stabbed interrupts their argument, and all eyes suddenly turn to Devran. At that very moment, it's revealed that Cemo can walk again. While his family is thrilled to see him back on his feet, the painful truth comes to light for Azize: Cemo was the one who stabbed Yavuz. Azize must remain silent to avoid losing her brother. Zeliha's decision to wear the headscarf creates a new storm within the family, while Firuze continues to corner both Azize and Devran with her behind-the-scenes schemes. As Yavuz continues to fight for his life, Cemo's fate hangs in his own hands.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: When Yavuz says, "Devran did it," chaos erupts in the hospital. Having skillfully escaped the police, Devran has now embarked on a path of no return: a war of revenge begins. Devran, who reunites with Cemo, Yusuf and Vahap, will both clear his name and personally give Yavuz the punishment he deserves. Melis's disappearance throws Haşmet, Necla, and Remziye into a panic. While Azize tries to save her sister Zeliha from Ayhan Hoca's influence, she is forced to deal with Haşmet because of Melis, who has taken refuge in her house. On Firuze's side, Bahar's plan to run away with Taylan is revealed, and the tension between mother and daughter grows even stronger.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Forced to withdraw his complaint in front of the police, Yavuz hands over the hotel to Devran. Though Devran returns to his hotel in apparent triumph, he knows this victory marks the beginning of a new war. Under pressure from Ayhan Hoca, Yusuf takes Zeliha, who is being forced into an unwanted marriage, to İbrahim Hoca. Torn between her faith and her desire for freedom, Zeliha begins to question her own path. Meanwhile, Melis’s announcement that she plans to marry Cemo sparks a major uproar within the family. Haşmet, Necla, and Remziye strongly oppose the relationship, but Melis refuses to back down. Determined to take revenge, Yavuz joins forces with Kevi and sets out from Mardin, a move that sends shockwaves through the entire apartment building. As Devran prepares for the inevitable war ahead, Azize, unaware of the storm about to break, stands firm in her resolve to confront Kevi face-to-face.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Kevi’s death throws everything into chaos. With the backing of the tribal leaders arriving from Mardin, Devran rises to the position of clan leader. Yet his victory is short-lived, a mysterious message spreads fear among everyone: Kevi’s grandson, Hazar, is on his way, seeking revenge. Cemo’s sudden marriage proposal to Melis shocks everyone, while Zeliha finds herself torn between protecting her family and accepting a proposal from Ayhan Hoca’s brother. Meanwhile, the Haşmet family, tired of being caught in the middle of a renewed feud, demands that Devran and his family leave the neighborhood. But Azize and her children refuse to back down, declaring, “This is our father’s home.” Their defiance reignites hostilities, setting the stage for another explosive confrontation between the two families.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: After the death of the fake Hazar, chaos erupts. Devran, falling into Aras’s trap, begins to suspect that İlyas and Çavuş are after the leadership of the tribe and decides to take action. But this time, he isn’t the only target, Yavuz sets his revenge plan into motion and kidnaps Samet. Meanwhile, Firuze learns that Bahar’s illness has worsened and that she needs a liver transplant. She asks Yusuf to be by Bahar’s side once again. As Devran and Azize mobilize to track down Yavuz, Aras and Bade get hold of information about Azize, something that could corner Devran completely.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Azize and her siblings are shaken by Samet's words, "My mother is alive!" While some of the siblings believe Samet, others think he is hallucinating due to the trauma he experienced. Aras and Bade realize that whoever seizes the goods will become the leader of the tribe; therefore, they use Bala as leverage against Devran in exchange for the goods. Devran is torn between becoming the leader of the tribe and saving Azize's mother, while the grim end awaiting him draws ever closer. Following Melis's accident, Haşmet experiences a real fear of loss for the first time and, for the first time, warms to the idea of ​​her marrying Cemo. Yusuf promises Firuze that he will support Bahar; however, Zeliha, who is only just beginning her recovery, is unaware of this.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Azize is devastated when she loses her mother again the moment she is reunited with her. Filled with anger and pain, Devran goes to the hotel, believing he has broken the agreement. While Devran tries to prove the truth, Vahap's confession that he hid the weapons to protect the family brings the relationship between father and son to a breaking point. Devran finds himself caught between the promises he made to Azize and his family. Although Haşmet tries to keep his mother away from Osman, things take a turn for the worse; Osman makes a sudden marriage proposal to Remziye. To prevent his mother from falling for Osman, his "worst nightmare," Haşmet devises new plans. Meanwhile, on Zeliha's side, the revelation of Yusuf's lies causes a major rift in their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Devran suffers a great blow with the shooting of Vahap Ağa. Seizing this chaos, Aras returns to the scene as Hazar Demirci. Having stolen the tribe's capital, Aras tries to win their support by sending a message to the tribal leaders. Meanwhile, the children, returning to the Uzunkaya farm, are devastated when their mother, Bala, who suffers from amnesia, rejects them. Determined not to leave the farm so that Bala can remember her past, the children continue their efforts. Zeliha, who faints upon seeing her mother, suspects she might be pregnant and decides to take a pregnancy test. Upon learning that Vahap has been shot, Azize stands by her husband, supporting the tribe during these difficult times. Meanwhile, Devran sets out to avenge his father and take over the leadership of the tribe, attempting to expose Hazar's true nature.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Devran ignites a major confrontation when Aras's true identity is revealed. To become the leader of the tribe, he must find the weapons, and he employs his toughest tactic to force Aras to talk by chaining him up in the cellar. As Bala confronts her past, she is driven to the brink of madness and decides to kill Yavuz. Zeliha learns she is pregnant; Yusuf is overjoyed, but the two must keep it a secret for now. Meanwhile, Süheyla lies to Melis, claiming she's pregnant, and Haşmet suddenly finds himself excited about becoming a father for the second time. Vahap, fighting for his life, opens his eyes and gives Devran a single order: eliminate Aras. Devran, while searching for weapons, is also on the verge of killing Aras under pressure from his father. But unexpected news will change everything.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: The revelation that Hazar is Devran's brother deeply shakes the Alazlar family. Believing that the only way to end this charade is to expose the truth to everyone, Devran decides to take a DNA test. When the pregnancy that Zeliha and Yusuf were trying to hide comes to light, a great storm brews between the families. While Haşmet categorically opposes the marriage, Yusuf remains determined not to give up the woman he loves. Bala, in turn, reassumes the role of "mother" that she had delegated to Azize long ago this return causes Azize to confront the burden she has carried for years. Devran is deeply shaken to see his mother embrace Hazar as her son while Pervin's declaration that the tribe should be jointly governed by Hazar and Devran turns all structures upside down.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Cemo's shooting of Haşmet escalates the tension between the two families to an irreversible point. While Haşmet fights for his life in the hospital, Cemo's action changes everyone's fate in a single day. On one side is Bala, sworn to protect her son at all costs, and on the other is Azize, who argues that paying the price for a mistake is the right thing to do.  Meanwhile, the storm continues on the Alaz front. Vahap and Pervin bring their sons, Devran and Hazar, together to rule the tribe. However, the two brothers disagree on the future of the tribe; Devran, unlike Hazar, wants to cleanse the tribe of its corrupt practices. Hazar, on the other hand, seizes the opportunity created by Cemo to quietly put his own plan into action.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Cemo's imprisonment exacts a heavy price for Azize's decision. Having made a great sacrifice to protect her siblings, Azize becomes the target of her mother Bala and her siblings' anger. Bala sees Azize as responsible for her suffering, and the family is on the verge of a true division. While Zeliha and Yusuf decide to leave everything behind, Haşmet is ready to try anything to bring his son back home. In Azize's absence, Bala faces the harsh realities of life. Fidan's illness makes this struggle even more difficult. Azize, struggling with loneliness and guilt, accidentally hits her mother-in-law Pervin with her car, disrupting the balance in the house. Devran cannot be by Azize's side due to a crisis within the tribe. Aysel's escape from a forced marriage pushes the tribe to the brink of a blood feud; Devran searches for a way to prevent disaster, while Hazar turns this uncertainty to his advantage, putting his plan to seize control into action.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: A great chaos ensues when Tufan kidnaps Azize to recover Aysel. Upon discovering that Azize is pregnant, Devran experiences the happiest moment of his life and, at the same time, great devastation. He enters a relentless race against time to save his wife and the unborn baby. Taking refuge on Yavuz's farm with her children, Bala places her hopes on the lawyer brought by Yavuz to save Cemo. Upon learning that her mother is on the farm, Azize has a major confrontation with Bala, in which all the scores from the past come to light. Meanwhile, Zeliha, who is pregnant, is hospitalized due to the risk of miscarriage. The doctor warns that she needs to stay completely away from stress, and Yusuf is forced to hide Azize's kidnapping from her. While Devran mobilizes all his efforts to rescue Azize, the fact that Hazar discovers she is pregnant turns all the plans upside down. To get rid of this baby, Hazar finds a dangerous path.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Azize suddenly falls ill in the forest and Devran rushes her to the hospital. Shaken by the fear of losing her baby, the sound of the baby’s heartbeat marks the start of a new chapter for the Alaz family. The doctor’s announcement of a “six-week pregnancy” brings great joy to the family, but sparks a major crisis for Hazar and Bade, who want to get rid of the baby and Devran. Azize opposes the ceremonial slaughter of a ram brought for the vow, having her own plans. Meanwhile, Pervin pushes to marry off her son Hazar quickly and proposes Melis as a “tribal bride.” To celebrate Azize’s recovery and the pregnancy, a grand family feast is held at the mansion. As the family gathers around the table, Tufan and his men, sworn to revenge, lay siege to the mansion. Devran is torn between his promise to his wife to “keep her hands clean” and his thirst for vengeance, forced to make an irreversible choice for the future of the Alaz family.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: The fact that Devran killed Tufan to protect his family reignites a blood feud that had lain dormant for years. Vahap Alaz, wanting to keep his son alive, signs an irreversible agreement that no one would have imagined: the first daughter Devran is born to will be promised in marriage, while still in her cradle, to Haydar's son. Azize faces a real test at home with the Mardin-style baby shower organized by Pervin and the impositions regarding the baby's name. Upon discovering that Devran secretly helped him, Yusuf cannot accept this in his pride and embarks on a dangerous path to prove that he is independent. When Devran discovers this terrifying agreement made by his father, his world crumbles. Willing to set the world on fire if necessary for his wife and unborn child, Devran confronts his father, but is forced to hide this dark secret from Azize.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: When Azize discovers the blood-feud pact made over her still-unborn child and the Alazlars’ dirty deal, her world collapses. Devran is devastated by his wife’s departure and, as he tries to convince Azize to return, he ends up cornered by pressure from his father, Vahap, and his mother, Pervin. Failing in their attempts to force Azize to come back, Pervin changes strategy. To take revenge on Azize and strike her at her weakest point, she decides to propose Melis in marriage to Hazar. For the Haşmetlers, who are facing financial difficulties, this proposal becomes an unmissable opportunity. Determined to put an end to the blood feud once and for all, Devran decides to face everything and meets with Haydar to seek common ground. However, influenced by Hazar’s manipulations, Haydar is convinced that Devran did not come to make peace, but to kill him. Devran, in turn, does not realize that he is racing headlong toward a deadly trap.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: With the car explosion that Devran was in, everyone is plunged into deep mourning. Amidst the wreckage at the scene of the tragedy, Azize, Pervin, and Vahap face the most painful day of their lives. But Azize refuses to believe Devran is dead. Taking advantage of the chaos, Hazar puts his treacherous plans into action. While pretending to mourn with his family, behind the scenes he works with his accomplice Bade to eliminate Haydar and Gülsüm once and for all. Hazar's true objective is to assume leadership of the tribe as soon as possible, marrying and taking power. However, Azize doesn't ignore her intuition. Following the clues, she discovers that Devran is, in fact, alive. Devran has secretly orchestrated his own "death game" to expose Hazar. The great reckoning will take place at Hazar and Melis's wedding. Just when everyone has lost hope, Devran's appearance will completely change the course of everything.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Devran, who was thought to be dead, returns crashing the wedding, completely disrupting Hazar's plans. Cornered, Hazar takes Melis hostage and escapes from the hotel. During this perilous journey, Melis tries everything to escape Hazar, but her life is in danger when she is stung by a scorpion in the forest. Devran, Yusuf, Azize, and Zeliha set out to catch Hazar and rescue Melis. However, their vehicle breaks down during the chase, forcing them to spend the night deep in the forest. Hazar, meanwhile, is ready to do anything to escape the police and flee abroad. On the other hand, Bala, Hamiyet, and other family members staying at the Alaz Hotel gather for the first pre-dawn meal of Ramadan. With this prepared meal, they try to support Necla and her family, who fear losing their child, and keep their spirits high, while everyone awaits news from Melis.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: While Azize and Devran await their baby, the other members of the family have started new chapters in their lives. The family reunites at the hospital following Zeliha's birth, and those who were estranged reconcile; especially Haşmet's meeting his grandchild and making amends with Yusuf and Zeliha dispels the dark clouds hanging over the family. Devran opens a new chapter in the tribe and cleanses it of its corrupt practices. This displeases the tribal leaders, who devise a new plan to eliminate Devran. Meanwhile, Yavuz, seeking atonement for his past mistakes, confesses his own crimes and surrenders to justice in exchange for Cemo's freedom.
